stops.title: Through Somerset House to the river terrace
stops.travel_text: Getting there: about 31 min: walk to Hyde Park Corner or Knightsbridge station, then take the Tube or bus to the Strand entrance (Temple or Covent Garden station).
stops.approach: From the Strand, go through the arch into the courtyard, cross it, and go through to the River Terrace.
stops.what: From the busy Strand you pass through the arch into the big, quiet courtyard, then out onto the terrace, where the Thames opens up in front of you.
stops.rain_swap: From Trafalgar Square into the quiet of the National Gallery, about 15 min away on foot.

stops.title: Across the Millennium Bridge towards St Paul's dome
stops.travel_text: Getting there: about 21 min: walk to Temple station, then take the Tube or bus to Tate Modern, Bankside (Southwark or Blackfriars station).
stops.approach: From Tate Modern's river side, step onto the south end of the bridge and walk north.
stops.what: You walk north across the steel footbridge, and St Paul's dome sits dead ahead, growing with every step.
stops.best_text: Best: At dusk, when the dome is lit
